[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Meta.Tactic.Simp

def implementation (s: String) : String :=
  s.split (fun c => c = ' ').map (fun word =>
    word.data.map (fun c => c.val.toNat).SortedList.map (fun c => c.toChar).toString).intercalate " "
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma split_intercalate_idempotent
(s: String)
: s.split (fun c => c = ' ').intercalate " " = s :=
by
  unfold split intercalate
  induction s generalizing s
  simp [s]
  simp [s]
  simp [s]
  simp [s]
  unfold split intercalate
  simp [s]
  simp [s]
  simp [s]
  simp [s]
  simp [s]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation s
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_words := result.split (fun c => c = ' ');
have h_s_words := s.split (fun c => c = ' ');
have h_words_eq_s_words_length := h_words.length = h_s_words.length;
have h_words_eq_s_words_length' := by

  induction s generalizing s
